title: Ep 7: Long Distance
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 7: Sagittarius is moving across the world for a year, and Cancer is proud and terrified. "I'm fine" only goes so far. Distance needs rituals, and room to say the hard part.

title: Ep 4: The First Fight
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 4: Taurus made soup, Gemini made plans, and someone ate the good bread. First fights happen. Name the need underneath, and fight the problem, not the person.

title: Ep 9: Saying It First
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 9: Virgo has three drafts and eleven footnotes for three little words. The pressure to say it perfectly is real. Say it plainly, let them answer in their own time.

title: Ep 3: Meet the Friends
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 3: Cancer brings Sagittarius to Sunday dinner, and the house rules don't last long. Meeting the friends is a lot. Include your person, check in quietly, don't spotlight them.

title: Ep 6: Jealous Moon
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 6: Capricorn laughs at someone else's joke, and Leo goes very quiet. Jealousy is information, not a verdict. Name the need under it and ask kindly to feel chosen.

title: Ep 5: Mixed Signals
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 5: pastries keep appearing in Libra's bag, and nobody will say why. Is it a crush or just great baking? Guessing games are exhausting. One true sentence beats a hundred hints.

title: Ep 8: Different Speeds
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 8: Pisces feels everything right now, Aquarius needs a quiet day to recharge. Neither need is a flaw. Ask plainly, agree on a signal, and remember quiet isn't goodbye.

title: Ep 2: Too Much, Too Soon
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 2: one date in and Aries has already named the dog. Excitement is lovely, but pace matters. Ask what feels good for them, and remember slow is still a yes.

title: Ep 10: The Block Party
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 10: the finale. Lamps on, lane full, and Libra has one question to ask Scorpio. Will the night cooperate? You don't need perfect timing. You just need to be brave once.

title: Ep 1: The Blind Card
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: Capricorn agrees to a blind card date, with a hard stop at 8:30. Will the agenda win? Being busy can be a way to stay safe. Make room for something good.
